definition: A schedule used to report and calculate overall this document from various transactions, including those reported on that document, and to determine the tax treatment of different types of capital gains.

includes.text: Aggregates gains and losses from a detailed transaction schedule and other sources
includes.quote: To figure the overall gain or loss from transactions reported on Form 8949

includes.text: Contains lines for short-term and long-term capital transactions

excludes.text: Does not report individual sales of capital assets; those are reported on a detailed transaction schedule instead
excludes.quote: Complete Form 8949 before you complete line 1b, 2, 3, 8b, 9, or 10 of Schedule D

excludes.text: Does not report dividend distributions directly; those are reported on a dividend and distribution statement
Does not report interest income; that is reported on a sibling schedule
excludes.quote: Schedule B (Form 1040) - Interest and Ordinary Dividends

discriminators.text: Aggregates and summarizes this document from multiple transactions already reported on that document; that document reports individual transactions in detail
discriminators.quote: To figure the overall gain or loss from transactions reported on Form 8949

discriminators.text: Reports this document from sales of securities and property; that document reports dividend and distribution income from investments
Reports this document from all sources including long-term transactions; that schedule reports only interest and ordinary dividends
discriminators.quote: To report capital gain distributions not reported directly on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 7a
